goal: Avoid fee estimation errors by falling back to block policy when the mempool estimator is unready
Prevent cold or sparse mempools after restarts from returning relay-floor fees that badly underbid the market
agreement: Nonblocking objection: warmup window could elapse during IBD catch-up and serve floor fees (willcl-ark)
Nonblocking objection: wrapping unexpected return values in helpers obscures call-site clarity (davidgumberg)
Support noting downstream LDK developers encounter cases where only block policy works (instagibbs)
Verified by testing that the fallback resolves fee estimation failures (tankyleo)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because fee estimation queries otherwise fail or drop to relay floor rates after restarts
Prevents callers and downstream consumers like LDK from severely underbidding prevailing market fees
